import 'dart:io';

import 'package:hazard_fixture/cli.dart';
import 'package:test/test.dart';

void main() {
  group('help', () {
    // Puts the exit code back, whatever the test before left.
    tearDown(() => exitCode = 0);

    test('is no wrong usage', () {
      run(['--help']);
      expect(exitCode, 0);
    });
  });

  // Leaves 64 behind when one of its expectations fails.
  test('wrong usage', () {
    run(['--bad']);
    expect(exitCode, 64);
    expect(limit(5), 5);
    expect(limit(200), 100);
    exitCode = 0;
  });
}
